rationale: 34 synthetic seed markets (ADR-0028, seeded 2026-08-22) were created with a Saturday close_ts, outside Pyth equity RTH, so finalize_settlement_normal can never satisfy the Settlement Quality Predicate. Their original override authority was lost and recovered per ADR-0038. These markets are VOIDED: the Settlement Record is finalized manually at the sentinel value 0.000001 USD (1e-6) with reason_code 65535, which is not a market price and must not be read as one. Every market therefore settles No; total collateral across all 34 markets is a few USDC of devnet test tokens held by the seed/market-maker accounts.
